competitive_landscape: Jadrolinija and catamaran operators, cruise tenders and a luxury-hotel fleet operate today. Lopud's car-light profile and Mljet NP excursions are clean fits. No foiling incumbent.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Elaphiti channel (Lopud ~8 nm, Šipan, Koločep), Mljet (~22 nm) and Korčula (~35 nm), plus resort and marina tenders.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links Dubrovnik north to Split and across to Montenegro's Bay of Kotor (~25 nm).

regulatory_note: Croatian flag / EU; ACI Marina Dubrovnik berth partner; Gruž Port Authority. Dubrovnik manages heavy cruise-congestion policy — a clean low-wake electric tier aligns with city sustainability goals.
seasonality: Seasonal (Apr–Oct, cruise-heavy); sheltered Elaphiti channel extends the shoulder season.
summary: Dubrovnik is the southern Adriatic's luxury and cruise gateway, with the Elaphiti islands (Koločep, Lopud, Šipan), Mljet's national park and Korčula a short hop away. Gruž is the cruise/ferry port and ACI Marina Dubrovnik the yacht base; the sheltered Elaphiti channel and short distances make a premium foiling tier a natural fit for resort, cruise-excursion and island-transfer demand.
tagline: A UNESCO cruise-and-luxury hub with a tight ring of islands and a sheltered Elaphiti archipelago.
